top_signals.title: Need Landing Zone For Capex Estimates: Karoui
top_signals.summary:
Lotfi Karoui, multi-asset credit strategist at Pimco, and Jeff Sherman, deputy CIO of DoubleLine Capital, join Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Real Yield." Meta said it has agreed to spend about $825 billion in the future on various leases and contracts, many of them related to computing power and infrastructure for artificial intelligence.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
